overview: A campus marketplace where students buy and sell items — from electronics and books to clothes and furniture. Post listings with photos, search by category or price, and contact sellers directly via WhatsApp.
features: Post items with up to 5 photos and category tags
Browse listings with search, filter by category and price, and sort options
Contact sellers instantly via WhatsApp redirect
Manage your own listings from your profile
Responsive mobile-first design for on-the-go browsing
